note: followup_cap: follow-up questions per question; same_target_cap: a target asked this many times and still open is not asked again; stop_after_unknown_once_asked: once the elder newly says 'can't remember / won't say' on an active target and at least this many follow-ups were asked, close instead of asking the next target. signal_close: when the elder's latest words literally say they won't talk about it / can't remember / are tired (interview.elder_signal), close instead of asking, whatever the engine decision ('ready' still closes as done; tired -> rest).
note_rest_resume: rest_resume_by_speaker: after the elder rests and taps 'continue', true = the speaking layer writes the line into the next question (v4e, untested); false = fixed '好，咱们接着聊。' + next entry (v4d).
note_deepen: deepen (v5a): on a story question (story-questions.json), after the ending rules say done (engine ready) and before the close, ask at most max_per_question detail questions (max_per_sensitive on sensitive ones), written by a separate call with deepen-prompt.txt (the v4d speaker prompt is unchanged). Not asked when the elder's latest answer has <= short_chars characters, says he can't remember / won't talk / is tired (elder_signal), or the question already has >= detailed_chars characters from the elder with >= detailed_dims of the four kinds (scene, people, detail, feeling); a failed or invalid deepen call means no deepen (the normal close follows). Deepen answers are not judged again (rejudge_answers false): they are kept verbatim as sources of this question. Without the deepen key (or enabled false) the policy is exactly v4d. drop_echo_ack (v5c): an ack whose content bigrams all reappear in the question is dropped. short_chars_first (v5e): before the first deepen question the short limit is short_chars_first instead (a brief answer that names someone or something may be asked about once; after a deepen question short_chars applies). extra_guards (v5c1): "想不出 / 说不出 / 没什么特别" also stop deepening (deepen only; the shared elder_signal is unchanged), and an ack with praise words (有意思 / 真好 / 难得 …) is dropped.
note_speaker_prompt: speaker_prompt (v5d): the speaking-layer prompt of this policy (follow-up + close); without it the v4d prompt of full-interview-v4 is used. The v4d file is not changed.
note_signal_scope: signal_scope (v5d): an answer whose literal signal is 'can't remember' (C01 elder_signal; for deepen also the v5c1 '想不出 / 说不出 / 没什么特别') and that goes on to tell something new (interview.signal_scope: >= scope_min_chars characters in clauses with >= 2 content bigrams not in the question just asked, the elder's earlier words of this question or a generic list) is partial: only that point is not pressed. Closing reason 'unknown_partial' instead of 'unknown'; on story questions the deepen step may follow what he went on to tell (still within its cap); an open point other than the one just asked may still be asked. Off: the C01 rules exactly as the backend has them.
note_guards: echo_guard (v5d): an acknowledgement (follow-up, deepen, close) that mainly restates the elder's latest answer is dropped (style.is_restate, as the restate metric). template_guard (v5d): a stock move-on clause before the next entry (咱们再聊聊 / 换个话题 / 接着聊) is dropped. v5e: echo_guard "clause" drops only the acknowledgement clauses of a close that restate on their own (the whole acknowledgement when only together they do); true (v5d) drops the whole acknowledgement. echo_fragment_chars (v5e1): when what the clause guard leaves leans on the clause it dropped (starts with 是 / 也是 / 真是 …: "是可怕。"), an acknowledgement of at most this many characters is kept whole, a longer one goes whole.
note_v5f: v5f (warmth): template_guard "repeat": natural move-on phrases (那咱们再聊聊 / 说起……) are allowed; a stock phrase (style.TEMPLATE) that an earlier close of the same session already used is dropped, and the entry is aligned first (interview.align_entry). echo_names: a short acknowledgement (<= 12 Chinese characters) is tested for restating with names of people and places masked (interview.mask_names), so naming someone he mentioned is not a restatement. echo_fragment_bare: what the clause guard leaves is only an interjection or one character -> kept whole or dropped whole by echo_fragment_chars, as a dependent fragment. deepen.no_yes_no: a deepen question ending in 吗 is not asked (no deepen, the close follows). deepen.no_repeat_last: after the elder answered a deepen question, a next one that only asks him to tell again what that answer told (interview.repeats_last) is not asked.
note_listen_first: 用户2026-10-27确认：先接住刚说的内容再针对性问问题。允许简短具体承接，禁止将降低复述率置于承接之上。空/不安全承接走保守兜底并留痕；不改变题库/目标/深挖上限。原v4d/v5f包保留作回放基线。

story_memory.memory_heading: 前面别的话题里已经讲过的（别请他再讲这些，也别顺着这些往下问）：
story_memory.redirect_direction: 他这次讲的大多是前面讲过的事：问这件事里前面没讲过的一处，或这个话题里的另一个人、另一件事
story_memory.redirect_note: 这一步：他这次讲的大多是别的话题里讲过的事。先简短接住，再问这件事里前面没讲过的一处，或者这个话题里的另一个人、另一件事；找不到就不问。

note_v62: V6.2 (BRIEF12, 2026-11-03; 用户：多攒不重复、可写进回忆录的故事素材): story_memory -- 代码维护本次采访已讲内容（各题状态里老人的原话：本模块前面各题 + 其他模块的检查点）；本题一句话的 4-gram 有 sentence_share 以上出现在前面某题原话里算“已讲过”。深挖输入列出本题里已讲过的句子（最多 max_items 句、每句截 clip_chars 字）与出处；“讲得很完整”只按新讲的部分算；只请他重讲已讲内容的深挖问句不问（no_told_repeat）；事实题（redirect_depths）回答 done 且本题原话有 min_share 以上、至少 min_retold_chars 字是已讲过的，在草稿入口前最多问 redirect_cap 句转向问（同一深挖步骤与提示，回答不再判定）。deepen.no_third_party：问别人之间怎么商量/交涉/开口的问句不问；deepen.repair_yes_no：“您还记得……吗”里本身带疑问词的改成开放问。reflection_brief：感悟题最多 followup_cap 次追问，本题老人原话已有 enough_chars 字时不再追问（收尾原因 enough）；草稿入口后的补充回答记下后承接一句直接进入核对，不再问“还有别的想补充的吗”。no_judgement：承接里评价老人或家里人的词（interview_speaker.EVAL_V62），老人本题原话没有时去掉。transition_pool v62：过渡短语池去掉近义重复，最近 transition_window 次收尾用过的不再用，兜底按收尾次数轮换。题库、题序、判定层 v3j、深挖上限、敏感题规则、thinking disabled 都不变。
note_v62_wording: 用户 2026-11-04（V6.1 第二轮云端问答，证据包 e46413df…）：close_style v62 -- 承接只是他几个字的碎片（interview_story.fragment_echo：不超过 14 字、四分之三以上的字是他本题原话、没有“原来/还/真/可/呀/不容易…”这类反应）时不说；ack_optional -- 没有可用承接时不再补固定兜底句，直接问或直接给草稿入口；下一题前的过渡短语只在上一次收尾没用过渡时才用（短语族在最近 transition_window 次内不重复），其余用“那 / 好，那 / 嗯，”轻接或不接；拒答承接轮换三种说法。no_third_party_ask：追问里问别人之间怎么说/商量/交涉的不问，换回判定层原问法。EVAL_V62 补“很实在/远见/盼着”等。

texts.life_intro: 您好，今天我陪您聊聊过去的事。咱们先从几个简单的问题聊起，慢慢来，不着急；记不清或者不想讲的，跟我说一声就跳过。
texts.life_review: 谢谢您跟我讲了这么多。这些是您讲的人生线索，请您先看看，有需要更正的地方可以告诉我；确认后再选想聊的部分。

note_v62b: V6.2b (BRIEF14, 2026-11-08): third_party_wide -- the third-party check also catches how others courted / got on / discussed / felt and their private matters; guide_handle -- when the elder only says he cannot remember / has nothing to say and nothing is recorded yet for the question, the speaking layer (task guide) gives one concrete, easy handle question (at most max_per_question per question); empty_no_draft -- a module question that ends with nothing told (only "记不清 / 没印象") gets no draft offer: it closes into the next question like a gentle skip; texts -- the warmer skeleton opening and the thanks before the skeleton review (fixed texts, no model call).
